interface.name: meridian_glass_manager_v1
interface.description: For the shell's panels, docks and menus: what is behind parts of a surface shows through them blurred and bent at their edges, as through a pane of glass. The surface draws over it, a tint that lets it show.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Glass got from it is left alone.

request.name: get_glass
request.description: A surface has at most one; a second is a glass_exists error.

interface.name: meridian_glass_v1

description.summary: the parts of a surface that are glass

interface.description: The shape, contrast and frost are double-buffered: requests change pending ones, which the surface's next commit makes its own. A surface starts with no shape, no contrast and a frost of 4.

entry.name: none
entry.summary: what is behind shows as it is

entry.name: dark
entry.summary: light content goes over the glass: what shows through is kept dark enough for it

entry.name: light
entry.summary: dark content goes over the glass: what shows through is kept light enough for it

description.summary: the surface is no longer glass
no part of the surface is glass

request.name: add
request.description: Adds a rectangle, in the surface's coordinates, with its corners rounded to radius, to the pending shape. Below an opacity of 1 what is behind shows through the blur, as it fades in or out with what the surface draws over it.

request.name: set_frost

description.summary: how much what is behind is blurred

request.description: From 1, a little, to 6, all but its colours; others are taken as the nearest of those.
